catalog.description: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
catalog.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Targets are stunned for 1s and break for 1s.
catalog.name: God's Rebuke
catalog.superUpgrade: Super: Increases crit by 65 and slow duration by 1.5s. Reduces cooldown by 4s.

catalog.description: Drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining it for itself and nearby controlled units.
catalog.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Also grants the buff to allies in 500 radius.
catalog.name: Grave Chill
catalog.superUpgrade: Super: Targeted unit is disarmed. Reduces cooldown by 3s.

catalog.description: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
catalog.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants Belch Exterior: grants 30% status resist, and any time a unit hits hero, there is a 30% chance they get belched on, and get stunned for 2s.
catalog.name: Grow
catalog.superUpgrade: Super: Removes attack speed reduction, and grants +51 bonus damage.

catalog.description: The hero calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants allies immunity from physical damage.
catalog.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: When an ally affected by Guardian Angel gets attacked, they have a 15% chance to cast a Hammer of Purity on their attacker.
catalog.name: Guardian Angel
catalog.superUpgrade: Super: Allies gain 40 health regeneration for the duration of the buff. +1s duration, -60s cooldown. Radius becomes global.

catalog.description: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to the caster.
catalog.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Silence also makes enemies miss 100% of their attacks. Doubles the knockback max distance.
catalog.name: Gust
catalog.superUpgrade: Super: Increases radius by 250 and reduces the cooldown by 3.
